script_line: A patient of mine. Nine years of knee pain.

risks.risk: the mug slides or melts into her hand
risks.prevented_by: her right hand stays round the mug; no mug moving by itself; HOLD-C
no speaking, no mouth moving; the action is a breath

risks.risk: the rub repeats as a loop
risks.prevented_by: one rub down and back over two seconds, then rests
